[Local bound after adjustment] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0190 ↗ lem:chow-iii-adjusted-bad-sequence 1. ch21:21.13\group Point picking

The adjustment implies $|\Rm _{g_i}|(x,t)<2|\Rm _{g_i}|(x_i,t_i)|$ for $t\in [t_i/2,\epsilon _i^2]$ and $d_{g_i(t)}(x,x_{0i})\le \epsilon _{0i}$.
